messages:
Elaine (marketing): Hey folks — preparing the benchmark slides + launch blog. Need a quick sanity pass on the ingestion + sampling methodology we used for the numbers we'll present. Can runtime team help validate and/or rerun the key workloads?

Elaine (marketing): Specifically we need:
• confirmation of sample sizes and sampling randomness
• which warmup tokens were used and whether cache/KV was cleared
• raw latency distributions (p50/p95/p99) and token counts
• artifact provenance (exact model commit, quantization config, container image)
• short reproducible commands or CI artifact links we can attach to the deck

Elaine (marketing): Primary models in scope: redwood-base-7b-qat, open-llama-3-13b-fp16. Priority: the 7B quantized results (used in hero claim).

Lucas (eng-runtime): Got it. Can you confirm the target prompt suite? small/medium/large lengths?

Elaine (marketing): Small: 16 tokens prompt -> 256 gen; Medium: 64 -> 512; Large: 128 -> 1024. Use the marketing canonical prompt set (shared earlier in gdrive).

Lucas (eng-runtime): Thx. We'll run a smoke + reproducibility sweep. Plan: smoke (50 samples) with cache disabled, full (500 samples) with same seed and warmup.

Lucas (eng-runtime): Quick commands for transparency (we'll push artifacts to CI):
```bash
bench-run --model redwood-base-7b-qat --payload-file marketing_prompts.json 
  --samples 500 --warmup 32 --disable-cache --seed 42 --metrics p50,p95,p99 --output /tmp/bench-redwood-base-7b-qat.json
```

Lucas (eng-runtime): For quantized profile, also include: `--quantize-profile q4_0` and attach `runtime-kernel-version` tag.

Sam (runtime): Adding note: we should capture coldstart vs warmed metrics. Marketing hero numbers must state "warmed (after 100 warmup tokens)" if using cache. If you want strict coldstart, we can report both. :ok_hand:

Maria (product): Important — call out any model fallbacks (e.g., switched to fp16 variant under high load). We can't imply single-model determinism if any routing happened.

Elaine (marketing): Good call. We'll include a small notes box. For the deck we prefer warmed numbers but include a coldstart appendix.

Lucas (eng-runtime): Running initial smoke now. I'll paste quick logs + p50/p95 once complete. ETA ~ 35m.

ci-bench-bot: smoke-run-started redwood-base-7b-qat samples=50 run_id=run_2145006792

ci-bench-bot: smoke-run-complete run_id=run_2145006792 status=ok p50=42ms p95=120ms p99=220ms mean_tokens=180

Lucas (eng-runtime): Smoke looks sane. p95 ~120ms for q7b-qat on a 4xA100 pool. I'll kick full run with 500 samples and attach metadata (git sha, image tag, kernel).

Elaine (marketing): Awesome — can you also export a CSV with raw per-sample latencies and the exact command line in a README we can link?

Lucas (eng-runtime): Yep — will upload to artifacts.redwood.com/marketing/2145006789/ and post the link here when done. CSV and JSON preserved, plus `run_manifest.txt` with all flags.

Sam (runtime): Scheduling note: if we run the 500-sample full replicate now, it may bump into nightly quantization jobs at 2am. I'll queue it during low contention window 0300-0400 UTC unless you need it earlier.

Elaine (marketing): Low contention window is fine. Would be great to have numbers by EOD tomorrow.

Lucas (eng-runtime): Kicked full run scheduled for 0300 UTC. We'll tag as `marketing-hero-2145006789`.

ci-bench-bot: scheduled run run_id=run_2145006899 scheduled_at=2145043200

Elaine (marketing): One last ask — please include quantized and fp16 variants side-by-side with identical prompts, and note any quality diffs (if you spot obvious hallucination regressions). If ops sees diffs we can append a qualitative note.

Lucas (eng-runtime): Will diff logits+sample outputs for a small subset (10 prompts) and attach a short note. If we see >2% top-line divergence for token-level choices we'll flag it.

Maria (product): Also confirm whether the embedding pipeline used any caching/nearest-neighbor warm caches — we need accurate embed latency for lead routing claims.

Lucas (eng-runtime): Embedding pipeline: we'll run an independent batch of 1000 samples with cold and warmed cache and include median/95.

Elaine (marketing): Thanks all. Please ping when artifacts are uploaded. I'll draft the deck text and avoid absolute claims until we have the final CSVs. :pray:

Sam (runtime): Pinged ops to reserve the GPU pool window. I'll post the artifact link once available.

ci-bench-bot: full-run-complete run_id=run_2145006899 status=ok p50=45ms p95=130ms p99=260ms artifacts_url=https://artifacts.redwood.com/marketing/2145006789/manifest.json

Lucas (eng-runtime): Artifacts uploaded: https://artifacts.redwood.com/marketing/2145006789/manifest.json
Included: raw_latency.csv, aggregated_metrics.json, run_manifest.txt, sample_outputs.json, diff_note.md

Elaine (marketing): Received — will review and draft hero copy. Thanks team! :rocket:
